source.stem: Why is the circulatory system of mammals described as a double circulation?

options.text: Blood flows firstly through arteries and then through veins.
Blood flows through the heart twice on one complete circuit of the body.
In the heart, blood flows firstly through atria and then through ventricles.
The atria and the ventricles contract alternately.

intelligence.enrichment: Mosquitoes pass through egg, larva, pupa, and adult stages. The egg develops into a larva, the larva grows into a pupa, and the pupa transforms into an adult mosquito. Observing each stage over time reveals the sequence: larvae become pupae, pupae become adults, and adults can lay eggs in stagnant water. The learner correctly applies this rule: Mosquitoes pass through egg, larva, pupa, and adult stages. The egg develops into a larva, the larva grows into a pupa, and the pupa transforms into an adult mosquito. Mosquito stages can be ordered by how much they look like an adult mosquito.
